deals.travelWindow: Nov – Jan, Allegiant nonstop; Jan 17/23/24/30 from $60 one-way, Nov dates $69–79
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way fares now from $60 (Jan) and $69–79 (Nov), so about $129–150 round trip; up from $104 yesterday but still the cheapest verified fare out of BOS.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Las Olas and Riverwalk, a free water taxi network, and cheap hostels near the beach make it easy alone.

highlights: Riverwalk and Las Olas Boulevard on foot
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the A1A promenade
Water Taxi day pass along the Intracoastal
Everglades airboat or Shark Valley tram day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Arrive FLL, beach and A1A walk, sunset at Las Olas Beach
Day 2 — Everglades day trip: Anhinga Trail at Royal Palm, then Shark Valley tram
Day 3 — Riverwalk, Water Taxi to Hugh Taylor Birch State Park, evening on Las Olas
guide.gettingAround: Airport is 3 miles from downtown; use Brightline/Tri-Rail, the Water Taxi and rideshare. Rent a car only for the Everglades day.
guide.stayArea: Beach area near Las Olas or downtown by Riverwalk: walkable with hostels and budget hotels.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 31 – early Dec, Allegiant nonstop; Nov 14 from $56 one-way, Dec 6 from $62
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant nonstop one-way from $56 (Nov 14), $62 (Dec 6), $84 (Oct 31), about $118–150 round trip, and Great Smoky Mountains NP is about 45 minutes away; a better pick than FLL for park access.
deals.soloWhy: Compact Market Square and Old City are walkable, locals are friendly, and the Urban Wilderness trails are inside the city.

highlights: Market Square and Old City evenings
Urban Wilderness trails and Ijams Nature Center
Smokies day trip: Alum Cave or Laurel Falls
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Sunsphere, Old City
Day 2 — Rental car to Great Smoky Mountains NP, Laurel Falls or Alum Cave Trail
Day 3 — Ijams Nature Center or Urban Wilderness loop, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable, but you need a rental car for the Smokies.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square, for walkability and food.

deals.travelWindow: Departing BOS Oct 13, 17, 20–21, 24, 27–28, 31; Nov 3–4, 7, 10–11, 14, 17–18; JetBlue nonstop
deals.whyRanked: JetBlue nonstop at $197 round trip (basic economy) with many Oct–Nov dates still open; pricier but a top solo city.
deals.soloWhy: Safe, walkable neighborhoods, hostels in the Gaslamp and Pacific Beach, and trolley plus coastal trails.

highlights: La Jolla cove and sea lions
itinerary: Day 2 — La Jolla cove and Torrey Pines State Reserve
Day 3 — Cabrillo National Monument, Little Italy
guide.gettingAround: The trolley and buses cover downtown and Old Town; rideshare for La Jolla and Torrey Pines.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Little Italy for transit, or Pacific Beach for hostels and surf.
food: Mission Hills fish tacos at Oscar's
